newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sudan president rules out reconciling with rebels.
newsitem.headline: Sudan president rules out reconciling with rebels.

text.p: Sudanese President Omar Hassan Al-Bashir ruled out on Wednesday any chance for reconciliation with the exiled opposition and rebel forces.

The official Sudan news agency SUNA quoted Bashir, addressing a labour union, as saying there would be no reconciliation with what he called "the traitors who fought the Sudanese people alongside the foreign invaders".
He said they "sit in hotels in Amman, Cairo, and London and conspire against the country and encourage its invasion".
Sudan has said that Ethiopian, Eritrean and Ugandan forces are supporting a rebel offensive launched just over a month ago across Sudan's eastern and southern borders.
The three countries deny helping the rebels and the Sudanese opposition National Democratic Alliance says its forces alone are responsible for all the military operations.
